Flow: the pubertal growth spurt by SITAR (Ho et al. 2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358986)

Source: R/flow-puberty.R
wgh_flow_pubertal_spurt.Rd

Age-density check, a SITAR model for boys (6 to 18 years) and a rule-based choice between three female specifications (6 to 16 years, 6 to 15 years, and the SITAR-d extension), identifiability checks, population APHV and PHV with cluster-bootstrap intervals (and the legacy interval for comparison), individual effects with vectorised individual APHV, links between prepubertal anthropometry and timing, and the early-timing logistic model with its AUC. Pass the returned report as spurt to the height prediction, velocity distribution, spurt duration and growth phenotype flows, so the SITAR models are fitted only once.

Usage

wgh_flow_pubertal_spurt(
  x = NULL,
  mode = NULL,
  ci_B = NULL,
  select_female = NULL
)

Arguments

x

Growth data with height, weight and year. When NULL, a simulated wgh_like cohort is generated.

mode

Run mode (see wgh_config()); NULL keeps the current mode.

ci_B

Bootstrap replicates for the APHV and PHV intervals (each refits SITAR). Default 0 in dev mode and 50 otherwise.

select_female

Run the three-model female selection (otherwise F1 only). Default: TRUE except in dev mode.

Value

A wgh_report whose models hold the SITAR fits and tables include individual_effects.

Examples

# \donttest{
rep <- wgh_flow_pubertal_spurt(growdat2_mini, mode = "dev")
#> SITAR fit failed with df = 4; retrying with df = 3.
rep
#> 
#> ── Pubertal growth spurt by SITAR (Ho et al. 2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358986) ──
#> 
#> Tables (7): age_density, model_diagnostics, aphv_phv_population,
#> individual_effects, individual_summary, timing_models, early_timing_logistic
#> Figures (3): fig_velocity, fig_height, fig_aphv_by_bmi
#> Models: sitar_male, sitar_female
#> Diagnostics: identifiability
#> Settings: mode = dev; ci_B = 0
rep$tables$population_aphv
#> NULL
# }
